Wasswa Peter Ssekyole
— About

A surveyor grounded in science & service.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Land Surveying from Ndejje University, Bombo, and I am a registered member of the Institution of Surveyors of Uganda (ISU). My practice combines rigorous field measurement with modern geospatial technology to produce reliable land information.

From cadastral boundary work and title-ready deed plans to engineering setting-out and GIS mapping, every project is executed with attention to legal compliance, surveying standards and client objectives.

— Services

Full-spectrum land
survey operations.

Every engagement begins with a site reconnaissance and ends with documentation you can act on.

01

Cadastral Surveys

Boundary opening, mutation surveys, subdivision, amalgamation and preparation of deed plans.

02

Topographic Surveys

Detailed terrain mapping with contours for design, planning and site analysis.

03

Engineering Surveys

Setting out for roads, buildings, drainage and infrastructure projects with millimetre precision.

04

Land Subdivision & Planning

Layout design, plot demarcation and physical planning support for estates and developers.

05

Title Processing Support

Preparation and submission of survey work for land titling and lease processing.

06

GIS Mapping & Analysis

Spatial data capture, geo-database design, thematic mapping and decision support.

07

GPS / GNSS Surveys

High-accuracy control surveys, georeferencing and coordinate transformations.

08

Boundary Disputes & Re-establishment

Expert site investigation and re-establishment of disturbed boundaries.
